description: The overflow menu can show only user, end-of-turn and notification messages. Conversation {{ID}} is an 18-turn conversation: each turn has a user message starting "Turn N:", an agent message starting "I'll work on turn N.", a tool call, and a final "Done with turn N."; turn 18 also has a notification starting "Warning on turn 18:". "Text X is present" means some element's text contains X; for "absent", check that document.body.textContent does not include X at all (hidden elements count too). Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{ID}}. 2. Wait for the first elements containing "Turn 1:", "I'll work on turn 1." and "Done with turn 1." to be visible, and the first data-testid "tool-call-completed" to be visible. 3. Click ".chat-overflow-menu-wrapper .btn-icon". 4. In data-testid "conversation-view-toggle", the button named "See All" should have aria-pressed="true". Click the button named "See End of Turn Messages Only": it should get aria-pressed="true". 5. The first elements containing "Turn 1:" and "Done with turn 1." should be visible, and the one element containing "Warning on turn 18:" should be visible. 6. "I'll work on turn 1." must be absent, and there must be no data-testid "tool-call-completed" (count 0). 7. localStorage "shelley-conversation-view" must be exactly "end-of-turn". 8. Reload by navigating to /c/{{ID}} again. 9. The first element containing "Done with turn 1." should be visible, and "I'll work on turn 1." must be absent.

steps.expression: (() => { const vis = (e) => { const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 0 && r.height > 0 && getComputedStyle(e).visibility !== 'hidden'; }; const norm = (s) => s.replace(/\s+/g, ' '); const all = (t) => [...document.body.querySelectorAll('*')].filter((e) => norm(e.textContent).includes(t) && ![...e.children].some((c) => norm(c.textContent).includes(t))); return [["first", "Turn 1:"], ["first", "I'll work on turn 1."], ["first", "Done with turn 1."]].map(([k, t]) => { const m = all(t); return (k === 'one' ? m.length === 1 : m.length > 0) && vis(m[0]); }).join(); })()
